## Purpose
The tool safety rules package. It defines what the AI may not design, request or build as a tool, configured on the Settings page. Rules apply at guidance points (added to prompts) or screen points (a check before code is built). Every rule ships switched off.

## Responsibilities
A docstring that maps the two modules, `store` and `apply`.
